verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hardware authenticator, since a buyer could reasonably ask whether credentials can be backed up or migrated. The evidence points the other way: private keys are generated on the hardware 'where it cannot be exported or extracted' (yubikey-docs-23), and users report you cannot simply replace a key but must re-enroll every account by hand (yubikey-comm-2). Support for open standards (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, OATH) lowers lock-in, but nothing in the pack shows any way to export a user's data in open formats.
